subject.title: feat(agents): add multi-pass context compaction with progress tracking

question: Should this PR be narrowed to safe production pruning/prefix repairs, or should maintainers sponsor a fully wired multi-pass compaction architecture in this branch?
rationale: The branch now contains a mix of production behavior changes, unintegrated internal multi-pass scaffolding, and overlapping architecture work already tracked in the compaction umbrella issue, so a maintainer needs to choose the intended landing shape after the correctness blockers are fixed.

options.title: Narrow and repair before merge
options.body: Keep only the production compaction improvements that respect existing recent-turn preservation, add focused regression coverage, and leave broader multi-pass design to the canonical architecture thread.

options.title: Sponsor full multi-pass integration
options.body: Treat this as the architecture branch, wire the multi-pass loop into real callers, and require fresh/upgrade/live-session proof before merge.

options.title: Pause in favor of canonical work
options.body: Close or pause this branch if maintainers want https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/58398 or a narrower timeout/pruning PR to own the direction instead.

recommendation.title: Narrow and repair before merge
recommendation.body: Keep only the production compaction improvements that respect existing recent-turn preservation, add focused regression coverage, and leave broader multi-pass design to the canonical architecture thread.

likelyOwner.reason: sallyom is the current live assignee on this external PR and is therefore the best available routing owner for the product-shape decision.
